0.kurzbeschreibung: The Achensee is Tirol’s largest lake—turquoise-blue waters framed by steep mountain slopes, famous as the "Sea of the Alps".

1.name: Arlberg
1.kurzbeschreibung: The Arlberg is the cradle of alpine skiing – legendary downhill runs, luxurious mountain villages, and untouched nature at over 2,800 meters elevation.

2.name: Außerfern
2.kurzbeschreibung: The Außerfern is the northwesternmost region of Tirol – a landscape of lakes and mountains with views of the Zugspitze, the wild Lech river, and picturesque villages.

3.name: Imst & Surroundings
3.kurzbeschreibung: Imst is the gateway to the Ötztaler Alpen – a city steeped in tradition, vibrant with Fasching celebrations, and brimming with alpine charm.

4.name: Innsbruck
4.kurzbeschreibung: Innsbruck – the Alpine metropolis with the world-famous Golden Roof, surrounded by mighty peaks and situated directly on the Inn River.

5.name: Kaunertal
5.kurzbeschreibung: The Kaunertal is Tirol’s quiet side – a high valley with a glacier ski area, deep gorges, and authentic alpine farming.

6.name: Kitzbühel
6.kurzbeschreibung: Kitzbühel – the legendary sports town in Tirol, famous for the Hahnenkamm-Rennen and surrounded by the Kitzbüheler Alpen.

7.name: Kufstein & Wilder Kaiser
7.kurzbeschreibung: Kufstein and the Wilde Kaiser – one of Tirol’s most stunning mountain backdrops, featuring the fortress of Kufstein and the majestic Kaisergebirge.

8.name: Landeck & Paznaun
8.kurzbeschreibung: Landeck and the Paznaun Valley – where the mountains stretch wider and the Oberinntal opens up into a grand alpine world.

9.name: Ötztal
9.kurzbeschreibung: The Ötztal is Tirol’s longest side valley—a realm of superlatives featuring mighty glaciers, the 3,768 m high Wildspitze, World Cup hub Sölden, and alpine wellness at Aqua Dome.

10.name: East Tyrol
10.kurzbeschreibung: East Tyrol is a sun-drenched alpine paradise between the majestic Hohe Tauern range with Mount Grossglockner and the rugged Lienz Dolomites.

11.name: Stubai Valley

13.name: Zillertal

1292.name: 007 ELEMENTS
1292.kurzbeschreibung: 007 ELEMENTS on the 3,048-metre Gaislachkogl peak in Sölden is an awe-inspiring subterranean James Bond cinematic installation at the authentic filming location of Spectre.

1293.name: Achensee
1293.kurzbeschreibung: Lake Achensee is Tirol's largest lake—a magnificent fjord-like expanse cradled between the Karwendel and Rofan ranges, renowned for watersports and crystalline water.

1294.name: Achensee Schifffahrt
1294.kurzbeschreibung: Achensee Passenger Shipping has operated since 1887, linking picturesque shoreline ports across Tirol's largest lake with a modern panoramic cruising fleet.

1295.name: Achensee Strandbad
1295.kurzbeschreibung: The lidos of Lake Achensee in Pertisau, Maurach, and Buchau feature manicured sunbathing lawns, shallow swimming bays, diving piers, and alpine watersports.

1296.name: Achenseebahn
1296.kurzbeschreibung: The Achensee Railway, steaming since 1889 as Europe's oldest purely steam-operated cog railway, ascends steeply from Jenbach to the sparkling shores of Lake Achensee.

1297.name: achenseebahn-dampfzahnradbahn-jenbach
1297.kurzbeschreibung: The historic Achenseebahn has been steaming from Jenbach up to Achensee since 1889 as Europe's oldest cog railway.

1298.name: Ahornbahn
1298.kurzbeschreibung: The Ahornbahn in Mayrhofen, Zillertal, is Austria's largest reversible aerial tramway, whisking visitors in 160-passenger cabins to the panoramic Ahorn leisure plateau.

1299.name: ahornbahn-mayrhofen
1299.kurzbeschreibung: The Ahornbahn, Austria's largest reversible aerial tramway, opens up leisure mountain Ahorn with AhornSee and the birds of prey Adlerbühne Ahorn.

1300.name: Alpbacher Seentour
1300.kurzbeschreibung: The Alpbachtal Lakes Circuit through Kramsach connects Tirol's warmest swimming lakes—including Reintalersee and Krummsee—on a picturesque woodland valley hike.

1301.name: alpenbad-leutasch-erlebniswelt
1301.kurzbeschreibung: Alpenbad Leutasch offers year-round recreation with an indoor pool, giant water slide, sauna oasis, and panoramic views of the Wettersteingebirge.

1302.name: alpenblumen-garten-kitzbueheler-horn
1302.kurzbeschreibung: The Alpenblumengarten at the Kitzbüheler Horn showcases more than 400 rare high-alpine plants at 1,880 meters amid a spectacular panoramic backdrop.

1303.name: Alpenblumengarten Kitzbüheler Horn
1303.kurzbeschreibung: The Alpine Flower Garden on the Kitzbüheler Horn at 1,880 m: over 400 rare high-alpine plants from all over the world on 20,000 m² of panoramic terrain.

1304.name: Alpengarten Kitzbühel
1304.kurzbeschreibung: The Alpine Flower Garden on the Kitzbüheler Horn at 1,880 metres displays over 400 high-alpine plant species from across the globe against iconic mountain peaks.

1305.name: Alpenrosenbahn Gondola Westendorf & Alpinolino
1305.kurzbeschreibung: The Alpenrosenbahn in Westendorf: 6-seater gondola ascending to 1,770 m to the Alpinolino discovery park featuring panoramic trails, Himmelsteig, and marmot rally.

1306.name: alpentherme-ehrenberg-reutte
1306.kurzbeschreibung: The Alpentherme Ehrenberg in Reutte offers soothing brine pools, water slide fun, and an award-winning sauna landscape.

1307.name: Alpenverein-Museum
1307.kurzbeschreibung: The renowned Alpine Club Museum in the Hofburg Innsbruck showcases the rich heritage of alpinism, mountain art, cartography, and historical mountaineering expeditions.

1308.name: Alpenzoo Innsbruck
1308.kurzbeschreibung: Alpenzoo Innsbruck at the base of the Nordkette range is Europe's highest-altitude themed zoo, showcasing over 2,000 alpine animals in natural hillside enclosures.

1309.name: alpenzoo-innsbruck-tirol-tiere
1309.kurzbeschreibung: As Europe's highest themed zoo, Alpenzoo Innsbruck showcases over 2,000 alpine animals in a natural setting on the slopes of the Nordkette.

1310.name: alpenzoo-innsbruck-tirol-wildtiere
1310.kurzbeschreibung: As the world's only themed alpine zoo, Alpenzoo Innsbruck features over 2,000 alpine animals in natural habitats on the slopes of the Nordkette.

1311.name: Alpinarium
1311.kurzbeschreibung: The Alpinarium Galtür combines a monumental 345-metre avalanche barrier wall with a modern discovery museum and indoor climbing wall on the high-alpine habitat.

1312.name: Alpinarium Galtür
1312.kurzbeschreibung: Alpinarium Galtür in the Paznaun Valley is an award-winning museum and memorial built directly into a massive 345-metre avalanche defense wall.

1313.name: alpinarium-galtuer-ausstellung-gedenkstaette
1313.kurzbeschreibung: The Alpinarium Galtür is a modern discovery museum inside a monumental avalanche barrier, exploring the relationship between humans and high mountains.

1314.name: Alpine Coaster Imst
1314.kurzbeschreibung: The Alpine Coaster in Hoch-Imst: At 3,525 metres in length, it is the longest alpine roller coaster in the world, packed with curves, waves, and hairpin bends.

1315.name: Alpinolino
1315.kurzbeschreibung: Alpinolino Westendorf at 1,770 metres on the Talkaser is an interactive alpine nature discovery park featuring sensory adventure trails for families.

1316.name: Alpsee
1316.kurzbeschreibung: Lake Alpsee and the Bärenbad lido in Berwang at 1,336 metres offer idyllic shoreline strolls, heated open-air pools, and alpine recreation in the Zugspitz Arena.

1317.name: Altfinstermünz
1317.kurzbeschreibung: Altfinstermünz in the rugged Inn River gorge near Nauders is a dramatic medieval border fortress, cave castle, and river toll bridge on the Via Claudia Augusta.

1318.name: altfinstermuenz-nauders-tirol
1318.kurzbeschreibung: Altfinstermünz is a medieval border and customs fortress nestled deep in the Inn Gorge, complete with wooden bridge and cave castle.

1319.name: Altstadt Hall in Tirol
1319.kurzbeschreibung: The historic old town of Hall in Tirol enchants visitors as western Austria's largest medieval core with Hasegg Castle, Mint Tower, and winding cobbled alleys.

1320.name: Altstadt Kufstein
1320.kurzbeschreibung: Kufstein's historic old town nestled below the fortress features the world-famous Römerhofgasse, painted facades, and vibrant Tyrolean hospitality.

1321.name: Altstadt Rattenberg
1321.kurzbeschreibung: Rattenberg is Austria's smallest town and delights visitors as the world-famous Glass Town with medieval flair and a traffic-free pedestrian zone.

1322.name: Annasäule Innsbruck
1322.kurzbeschreibung: The St. Anne's Column in Innsbruck's Maria-Theresien-Straße: erected 1704–1706 by Cristoforo Benedetti from red Kramsach marble in gratitude for the liberation of the state in 1703.

1323.name: Aqua Dome
1323.kurzbeschreibung: Aqua Dome – Tirol Therme Längenfeld in the Ötztal Valley is an architecturally futuristic alpine thermal spa featuring levitating outdoor pool basins and world-class saunas.

1324.name: aqua-dome-therme-laengenfeld
1324.kurzbeschreibung: The Aqua Dome in Längenfeld is Tirol's largest thermal spa, featuring floating basin bowls and thermal sulphur water.

1325.name: aqua-dome-therme-laengenfeld-wellness
1325.kurzbeschreibung: The Aqua Dome in Längenfeld delights with futuristic basin bowls, healing thermal water, and a breathtaking Ötztal mountain panorama.

1326.name: Area 47
1326.kurzbeschreibung: Area 47 at the gateway to the Ötztal Valley is Austria's premier outdoor adventure park, renowned for its giant Water AREA, wakeboard lake, whitewater rafting, and canyoning.

1327.name: area-47-oetztal-action-park
1327.kurzbeschreibung: AREA 47 at the entrance of the Ötztal is Austria's largest outdoor adventure park, featuring the Water AREA, giant slides, wakeboarding, and rafting.

1328.name: Museum St. Anton am Arlberg (Kandahar-Haus)
1328.kurzbeschreibung: The Museum St. Anton am Arlberg in the historic Kandahar-Haus from 1912: cradle of alpine skiing, Hannes Schneider, and classic alpine cinema.

1329.name: Audioversum ScienceCenter Innsbruck
1329.kurzbeschreibung: The Audioversum ScienceCenter in Innsbruck: An interactive discovery world dedicated to hearing, wonder, and sensory perception with hands-on exhibits.

1330.name: Augustiner-Museum Rattenberg
1330.kurzbeschreibung: The Augustinian Museum in Rattenberg: a high-class sacred art museum in the Gothic Augustinian monastery from 1385 with an accessible church tower.

1331.name: augustiner-museum-rattenberg-tirol
1331.kurzbeschreibung: The Augustinermuseum in Rattenberg presents precious Tyrolean sacred art and an accessible church tower inside a former Augustinian monastery.

1332.name: Hoadlbahn Cable Car Axamer Lizum & Hoadl
1332.kurzbeschreibung: The modern Hoadlbahn in the Axamer Lizum at 2,340 m: Hoadl-Haus featuring the Alps' largest covered panoramic terrace with views of the Kalkkögel.

1333.name: badesee-going-wilder-kaiser
1333.kurzbeschreibung: Badesee Going is among Tirol's most beautiful natural swimming lakes, featuring a white sandy beach and Kaiser mountain spring water.

1334.name: badesee-weisslahn-terfens-natursee
1334.kurzbeschreibung: The Freizeitzentrum Weisslahn in Terfens features an idyllic swimming lake with sunbathing lawns and a diverse range of sports facilities.

1335.name: badesee-weisslahn-terfens-silberregion
1335.kurzbeschreibung: Freizeitzentrum Weisslahn in Terfens offers an idyllic swimming lake with clean groundwater and numerous sports opportunities.

1336.name: Basilika Wilten
1336.kurzbeschreibung: The Wilten Basilica in Innsbruck is celebrated as one of Austria's finest Rococo churches, adorned with pastel stuccowork and Marian pilgrimage heritage.

1337.name: Benni-Raich-Brücke Arzl im Pitztal
1337.kurzbeschreibung: The Benni Raich Bridge in Arzl: At 94 meters high, Austria's highest pedestrian suspension bridge over the wild Pitzenklamm with bungee jumping and views.

1338.name: Tiroler Bergbau- und Hüttenmuseum Brixlegg
1338.kurzbeschreibung: The Mining and Smelting Museum in Brixlegg: mining history of the Lower Inn Valley with copper smelting, Fugger tradition, and a rich mineral collection.

1339.name: Mining Museum Hall in Tirol
1339.kurzbeschreibung: The Bergbaumuseum in Hall in Tirol: a faithfully recreated salt mine gallery in a vaulted cellar in the historic town centre featuring a slide, tools, and minerals.

1340.name: Bergdoktorhaus Köpfinghof Going
1340.kurzbeschreibung: The Bergdoktorhaus Köpfinghof in Going am Wilden Kaiser: original filming location of the hit ZDF TV series featuring a traditional parlour, herb garden, and Kaiser view.

1341.name: Bergeralm Adventure World Steinach am Brenner
1341.kurzbeschreibung: The Bärenbachl adventure realm on the Bergeralm in Steinach: water play park at 1,600 m in the Wipptal featuring a raft pond, tree house, and nature trail.

1342.name: Bergisel-Schanze
1342.kurzbeschreibung: The Bergiselschanze in Innsbruck blends Olympic ski jumping heritage with futuristic architecture by Zaha Hadid, an inclined lift, and a 360-degree panoramic tower.

1343.name: bergisel-sprungschanze-innsbruck-stadion
1343.kurzbeschreibung: The Bergisel-Sprungschanze designed by Zaha Hadid is a world-renowned masterpiece of sports architecture with a panoramic restaurant and far-reaching views.

1344.name: berglift-st-johann-harschbichlbahn
1344.kurzbeschreibung: The Harschbichlbahn in St. Johann provides access to the Harschbichl at 1,604 metres, featuring the Hornpark climbing forest, mountaincart track, and Wilder Kaiser views.

1345.name: Berglsteiner See
1345.kurzbeschreibung: Lake Berglsteiner at 713 m above sea level: a hidden forest lake natural monument between Breitenbach and Kramsach with a circular path, sunbathing lawn, and restaurant.

1346.name: berglsteiner-see-breitenbach
1346.kurzbeschreibung: Berglsteiner See between Breitenbach and Kramsach is an enchanted natural lake surrounded by mythical scenery.

1347.name: East Tyrol Biathlon Center Obertilliach
1347.kurzbeschreibung: The Biathlonzentrum Osttirol in Obertilliach at 1,400 m: World Cup training venue with 30 small-bore shooting lanes, roller ski track, and guest biathlon.

1348.name: Bichlalm
1348.kurzbeschreibung: The idyllic Bichlalm pasture at 1,600 metres above Kitzbühel captivates visitors with sunny alpine meadows, the scenic chairlift, and sweeping vistas of the Wilder Kaiser.

1349.name: Birgitzköpfl & Axamer Lizum
1349.kurzbeschreibung: The Birgitzköpfl at 2,039 m in the Axamer Lizum near Innsbruck: spectacular panoramic mountain at the foot of the Kalkkögel with scenic trails and via ferratas.

1350.name: Blindsee Biberwier
1350.kurzbeschreibung: Blindsee lake near Biberwier at 1,093 m on the Fernpass: turquoise-blue high mountain lake with a sunken forest, a diving Eldorado, and Zugspitze views.

1351.name: blindsee-zugspitzarena-tirol
1351.kurzbeschreibung: The turquoise Blindsee below the Fernpass is a breathtaking mountain lake and an internationally renowned diving destination.

1352.name: Botanischer Garten der Universität Innsbruck
1352.kurzbeschreibung: The Botanical Garden of Innsbruck University in Hötting: Over two hectares of alpine and tropical plant diversity, greenhouses, and a fragrant herb garden.

1353.name: Brandstadl Scheffau (KaiserWelt)
1353.kurzbeschreibung: The Brandstadl in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser: 1,650 m altitude, Brandstadlbahn, KaiserWelt play park in the magic forest, and dream panorama of the Wilder Kaiser.

1354.name: BrauKunstHaus Zillertal Bier Zell
1354.kurzbeschreibung: The BrauKunstHaus in Zell am Ziller: Tyrol's most modern beer experience world spanning over 5,000 m² with brewing art, Tyrolean cultural history, and tasting.

1355.name: braukunst-haus-zillertal-bier-zell
1355.kurzbeschreibung: The BrauKunstHaus in Zell am Ziller offers a multimedia journey through 500 years of Tyrolean brewing history, topped off with a beer tasting.

1356.name: Brennerpass
1356.kurzbeschreibung: The storied Brenner Pass (1,370 m) links North and South Tyrol: historic Roman crossing, outlet shopping, scenic cycle path, and key transport artery.

1357.name: Lake Brennersee Gries am Brenner
1357.kurzbeschreibung: Brennersee at 1,310 m near the mountain pass: a pristine mountain lake and source of the Sill with emerald-green waters, a circular lakeside trail, and rich fish stocks.

1358.name: Burg Berneck
1358.kurzbeschreibung: Burg Berneck perches dramatically on a sheer schist cliff 130 meters above the Faggenbach gorge at the entrance to the Kaunertal.

1359.name: Burg Bideneck Fließ
1359.kurzbeschreibung: Bideneck Castle near Fließ at 1,050 m: proud spur castle from the 13th century in the Upper Court with a 30 m keep, swallowtail battlements, and noble history.

1360.name: Burg Bruck
1360.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Bruck in Lienz – medieval castle residence of the Counts of Görz with a massive keep, Romanesque double chapel, and the world’s largest Albin Egger-Lienz gallery.

1361.name: burg-bruck-museum-lienz-osttirol
1361.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Bruck in Lienz was once the residence of the Grafen von Görz and now houses the Museum of the City of Lienz with the Albin Egger-Lienz gallery.

1362.name: Burg Freundsberg
1362.kurzbeschreibung: Stately Burg Freundsberg towers above Schwaz as the historic landmark of the Silver Region, featuring a museum, chapel, and restaurant.

1363.name: burg-freundsberg-schwaz-tirol
1363.kurzbeschreibung: Perched high above Schwaz, Burg Freundsberg houses the municipal museum dedicated to local mining history within its Romanesque keep.

1364.name: Burg Hasegg
1364.kurzbeschreibung: Burg Hasegg in Hall in Tirol is the birthplace of the silver thaler, featuring the iconic Mint Tower and interactive coin museum.

1365.name: Burg Heinfels
1365.kurzbeschreibung: The imposing hilltop fortress Burg Heinfels in East Tyrol's Hochpustertal reigns as the Queen of the Pustertal with panoramic views and museum exhibitions.

1366.name: Heinfels Castle East Tyrol
1366.kurzbeschreibung: Burg Heinfels in East Tyrol's Hochpustertal: the 'Queen of the Pustertal' perched on a steep rocky hill with a modern museum and panoramic circular tour.

1367.name: Burg Kronburg
1367.kurzbeschreibung: The ruined hilltop fortress of Burg Kronburg towers over Zams and Schönwies with its pilgrimage church, monastery inn, and valley panoramas.

1368.name: burg-kronburg-zams-tirol
1368.kurzbeschreibung: The ruins of Burgruine Kronburg perch boldly on a rocky cone above Zams, offering spectacular panoramic views over the Inntal.

1369.name: Burgruine Kropfsberg
1369.kurzbeschreibung: The Kropfsberg Castle Ruin near Brixlegg: mighty three-tower fortress of the Archbishops of Salzburg from the 13th century at the intersection of the Inn Valley and Ziller Valley.

1370.name: burg-kropfsberg-inn-st-gertraudi
1370.kurzbeschreibung: The castle ruin Burg Kropfsberg near St. Gertraudi was once a mighty fortress of the Salzburg archbishops overlooking the Inntal.

1371.name: Burg Landeck
1371.kurzbeschreibung: Historic Schloss Landeck overlooks the town, housing the regional museum, a late Gothic chapel, and a scenic observation tower.

1372.name: Burg Laudegg
1372.kurzbeschreibung: The picturesque hilltop fortress Burg Laudegg towers above the castle pond in Ladis on a steep slate crag with its Romanesque stone keep.

1373.name: burg-laudegg-ladis-tirol
1373.kurzbeschreibung: Burg Laudegg perches on a sheer slate cliff above the castle pond in Ladis, defining the iconic panorama of the sun terrace.

1374.name: Burg Tratzberg
1374.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Tratzberg near Jenbach delights visitors as an impeccably preserved Renaissance jewel perched high above the Inn Valley with lavish state rooms.

1375.name: Burgruine Vilsegg
1375.kurzbeschreibung: The romantic castle ruin of Vilsegg crowns a rocky ridge near Vils in the Außerfern, offering sweeping vistas across the Tannheimer Tal and Allgäu alpine foothills.

1376.name: Vilsegg Castle Ruins Vils
1376.kurzbeschreibung: The castle ruins of Burgruine Vilsegg near Vils in the Außerfern: romantic 13th-century Staufer rock castle on a forested hill near the Bavarian border.

1377.name: Burg Wiesberg
1377.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Wiesberg perches boldly upon a cliff at the gateway to the Paznaun Valley directly beside the spectacular Trisanna Bridge of the Arlberg Railway.

1378.name: Burgenwelt Ehrenberg
1378.kurzbeschreibung: Burgenwelt Ehrenberg near Reutte enchants as a monumental fortress complex featuring an interactive knight museum, castle ruins, and alpine scenery.

1379.name: burgenwelt-ehrenberg-klause-reutte
1379.kurzbeschreibung: Burgenwelt Ehrenberg in Reutte encompasses four historic fortifications, the knight adventure museum, and the baroque Klause.

1380.name: Burgruine Ehrenberg
1380.kurzbeschreibung: The Ehrenberg Castle ruins near Reutte tower as a 13th-century hilltop stronghold, standing as the historic centrepiece of the Burgenwelt ensemble.

1381.name: burgruine-kropfsberg-inntal
1381.kurzbeschreibung: The Burgruine Kropfsberg near St. Gertraudi was a mighty Salzburg border fortress with three preserved defensive keeps.

1382.name: burgruine-rattenberg-tirol
1382.kurzbeschreibung: The Burgruine Rattenberg is perched on the Schlossberg above Austria's smallest town and serves as an open-air stage.

1383.name: Burgruine Schrofenstein
1383.kurzbeschreibung: The daring Schrofenstein Castle ruins near Stanz and Landeck cling dramatically to a vertical cliff face high above the Inn Valley.

1384.name: Burgruine Thaur
1384.kurzbeschreibung: The romantic castle ruin of Thaur above the Inn Valley features the charming Romedikirchl chapel, historic castle cellars, and glorious Karwendel panoramas.

1385.name: burgruine-thaur-innsbruck-tirol
1385.kurzbeschreibung: The Burgruine Thaur near Innsbruck was once the ancestral seat of the Grafen von Andechs and offers panoramic views across the Inntal.

1386.name: Chasa Retica Spiss
1386.kurzbeschreibung: The Chasa Retica in Spiss: Rhaeto-Romanic cultural museum in Austria's highest municipality at 1,653 m above sea level on the border to Engadin.

1387.name: Defereggental
1387.kurzbeschreibung: The pristine Defereggental valley in East Tyrol enchants visitors with historic Jagdhausalm, healing thermal waters, and untamed alpine nature.

1388.name: Deferegger Heilwasserwelt St. Jakob
1388.kurzbeschreibung: The Deferegger Heilwasserwelt in St. Jakob: 600,000-year-old fossil deep healing water from a depth of 1,850 m with a modern visitor centre and graduation tower.

1389.name: Dom zu St. Jakob Innsbruck
1389.kurzbeschreibung: The baroque Cathedral of St. James in Innsbruck impresses with magnificent ceiling frescoes by the Asam brothers, the revered Cranach Mariahilf painting, and festive organ chimes.

1390.name: Lake Drachensee Ehrwald
1390.kurzbeschreibung: Lake Drachensee at 1,910 m near Ehrwald: High-alpine mountain lake directly below the Coburger Hütte, famous for deep-emerald waters and dramatic limestone crags.

1391.name: Ehrwalder Alm
1391.kurzbeschreibung: The Ehrwalder Alm at 1,500 m at the foot of the Zugspitze: modern 8-seater gondola, barrier-free Tirolerhaus, and the gateway to Seebensee and Drachensee.

1392.name: Ellmi's Zauberwelt Hartkaiser Ellmau
1392.kurzbeschreibung: Ellmi's Zauberwelt at the Hartkaiser in Ellmau at 1,555 m: 4,000 m² nature adventure park with enchanted forest, climbing castle, and panoramic views of the Wilder Kaiser.

1393.name: ellmis-zauberwelt-hartkaiser-ellmau
1393.kurzbeschreibung: Ellmi's Zauberwelt on the Hartkaiser in Ellmau is a 4,000 m² alpine children's adventure park set against the backdrop of the Wilder Kaiser.

1394.name: ellmis-zauberwelt-hartkaiser-ellmau-berg
1394.kurzbeschreibung: Ellmis Zauberwelt on the Hartkaiser in Ellmau invites children at 1,555 metres into a magical enchanted forest adventure with mythical creatures.

1395.name: Engalm
1395.kurzbeschreibung: The historic Engalm alpine hamlet at the Großer Ahornboden captivates with a traditional show dairy, centuries-old sycamore maples, and Karwendel cliffs.

1396.name: ErlebnisSennerei Zillertal Mayrhofen
1396.kurzbeschreibung: The Zillertal Dairy World in Mayrhofen: show dairy spanning 6,000 m², show farm with animals, and tasting of Zillertal hay milk specialties.

1397.name: ErlebnisSennerei Zillertal Dairy Mayrhofen
1397.kurzbeschreibung: The ErlebnisSennerei Zillertal in Mayrhofen: show dairy across 6,000 m², show farm with animals, and tastings of genuine Tyrolean hay milk.

1398.name: erlebnis-sennerei-zillertal-mayrhofen-kaeserei
1398.kurzbeschreibung: The ErlebnisSennerei Zillertal in Mayrhofen showcases the processing of pure hay milk inside a glass-fronted dairy and offers tastings.

1399.name: Erlebnis-Sennhütte Alpine Hut St. Anton am Arlberg
1399.kurzbeschreibung: Erlebnis-Sennhütte in St. Anton am Arlberg at 1,500 m: world's largest edelweiss with over 100,000 blossoms, the WunderWanderWeg trail, and authentic alpine charm.

1400.name: Spieljoch Adventure Mountain Fügen
1400.kurzbeschreibung: The Erlebnisalm Spieljoch in Fügen in the Zillertal: 10-seater gondola to 1,865 m featuring a water play park, flying fox, barefoot trail, and show mine.

1401.name: erlebnisbad-mayrhofen-zillertal-oase
1401.kurzbeschreibung: The Erlebnisbad Mayrhofen in the Zillertal delights visitors with giant slides, a wild water rapids canal, outdoor pools, and an expansive sauna landscape.

1402.name: Erlebnisberg Achensee
1402.kurzbeschreibung: The Rofan adventure mountain above Lake Achensee offers thrilling sky glider flights, panoramic trails, via ferratas, and scenic lake views.

1403.name: Golzentipp Adventure Mountain Obertilliach
1403.kurzbeschreibung: Golzentipp at 2,317 m in Obertilliach: East Tyrol's most scenic family adventure mountain featuring a 10-seater gondola, Jufenkamm ridge, and Dolomites views.

1404.name: Erlebnispark Familienland PillerseeTal
1404.kurzbeschreibung: Erlebnispark Familienland in St. Jakob in Haus: over 50 attractions, Austria's highest family roller coaster, pirate ship, and Dead Sea salt grotto.

1405.name: Erlebnispark Hög Serfaus
1405.kurzbeschreibung: Hög Adventure Park in Serfaus at 1,820 m: idyllic Högsee lake with boats, Family Coaster Schneisenfeger, lumberjack area, and family recreation.

1406.name: erlebnispark-hoeg-serfaus-almerlebnis
1406.kurzbeschreibung: The Erlebnispark Hög in Serfaus delights visitors around the Högsee with aquatic activities, the Schneisenfeger alpine coaster, and authentic mountain charm.

1407.name: Erlebnistherme Zillertal
1407.kurzbeschreibung: The Erlebnistherme Zillertal in Fügen offers vibrant aquatic fun, thrilling water slides, and a generous wellness and sauna world for the entire family.

1408.name: erlebnistherme-zillertal-fuegen
1408.kurzbeschreibung: The Erlebnistherme Zillertal in Fügen offers exhilarating water fun with giant slides, a wave pool, and a large sauna landscape.

1409.name: Fasnachtshaus Nassereith
1409.kurzbeschreibung: The Nassereith Carnival House: award-winning traditional museum for the Schellerlaufen with over 400 artistic wooden masks by master carvers.

1410.name: Felixé Minas Haus Tannheim
1410.kurzbeschreibung: The Felixé Minas House in Tannheim: 300-year-old listed townhouse with original Baroque and Biedermeier living culture in the Tannheimer Tal.

1411.name: Fernpass
1411.kurzbeschreibung: The Fern Pass at 1,216 metres is a storied alpine mountain pass between Reutte and Imst, celebrated for its Zugspitze panoramas, Lake Blindsee, and Roman history.

1412.name: Festung Kufstein
1412.kurzbeschreibung: Festung Kufstein crowns a 90-metre rock above the River Inn featuring the Kaiserturm, Heroes’ Organ, rock tunnels, and the Kaiser Maximilian panorama funicular.

1413.name: Heroes' Organ Kufstein Fortress
1413.kurzbeschreibung: The Heldenorgel at Festung Kufstein: with 4,948 pipes the world's largest open-air organ, heard daily at 12:00 noon across the entire town.

1414.name: festung-kufstein-kulturdenkmal
1414.kurzbeschreibung: Festung Kufstein towers over the town as a mighty cultural monument, captivating visitors with its history and the famous Heldenorgel.

1415.name: Festung Nauders
1415.kurzbeschreibung: Nauders Fortress at Reschen Pass: monumental five-story Habsburg road barrier from 1840, carved deep into the rock with a Kaiserschützen Museum.

1416.name: festung-nauders-reschenpass
1416.kurzbeschreibung: Festung Nauders is a completely preserved 19th-century Habsburg valley barrier built to secure the Reschenpass.

1417.name: FeuerWerk HolzErlebnisWelt Fügen
1417.kurzbeschreibung: FeuerWerk in Fügen, Zillertal: Europe's most modern biomass combined heat and power plant by the Binderholz Group, featuring a Wood Discovery World, sculpture garden, and rooftop terrace.

1418.name: feuerwerk-holz-erlebniswelt-fuegen
1418.kurzbeschreibung: FeuerWerk in Fügen showcases sustainable wood processing, biomass energy, and the SichtbarBar panoramic gallery as the HolzErlebnisWelt.

1419.name: Fichtenschloss & Fichtensee Rosenalm
1419.kurzbeschreibung: Fichtenschloss on the Rosenalm in Zell am Ziller at 1,700 m: over 5,000 m² wooden adventure world with four towers, climbing area, and swimmable Fichtensee.

1420.name: Fisser Flitzer Alpine Coaster Fiss
1420.kurzbeschreibung: The Fisser Flitzer on the Möseralm in Fiss: 2.2 km long alpine coaster with a 370 m elevation drop, banked turns, jungle cave, and ice cave.

1421.name: Fisser Sonnenterrasse
1421.kurzbeschreibung: The Fiss Sun Terrace at 1,436 metres in the Upper Inn Valley is Tirol's sunniest high plateau, boasting 2,000 sunshine hours, panoramic vistas, and family alpine parks.

1422.name: Flexenpass
1422.kurzbeschreibung: The 1,773 m high Flexenpass links Tyrol and Vorarlberg with historic rock galleries, steep gorges, and sweeping alpine vistas.

1423.name: Franziskanerkloster Schwaz
1423.kurzbeschreibung: Founded in 1507 by Emperor Maximilian I, the Franciscan Monastery in Schwaz houses a world-renowned Gothic cloister with 22 Passion frescoes.

1424.name: freizeitpark-salvenaland-hopfgarten
1424.kurzbeschreibung: Salvenaland in Hopfgarten im Brixental combines a swimming lake, heated outdoor pool, summer toboggan run, and adventure playground.

1425.name: gaislachkoglbahn-soelden
1425.kurzbeschreibung: The futuristic Gaislachkoglbahn ascends to over 3,000 metres above sea level to the James Bond experience 007 ELEMENTS.

1426.name: Gaistal Leutasch
1426.kurzbeschreibung: The Gaistal valley near Leutasch at over 1,200 m: untouched alpine pasture paradise between Wetterstein and Mieminger Chain, Ganghoferweg trail and Igelsee lake.

1427.name: Galerie im Alten Rathaus
1427.kurzbeschreibung: The Museum Kitzbühel at Hinterstadt 32 showcases over 60 original paintings by Alfons Walde, 3,000 years of mining history, and scenic rooftop views.

1428.name: Galitzenklamm
1428.kurzbeschreibung: Galitzenklamm gorge near Lienz in East Tirol is a thundering natural ravine nestled at the foot of the Lienz Dolomites, featuring footbridges, via ferratas, and a forest park.

1429.name: galitzenklamm-lienz-osttirol-wasserschaupfad
1429.kurzbeschreibung: The Galitzenklamm near Lienz impresses as a water adventure trail with roaring waterfalls, via ferratas, a water play park, and a historic mill.

1430.name: Geierwally Freilichtbühne Elbigenalp
1430.kurzbeschreibung: The Geierwally Open-Air Stage in Elbigenalp: spectacular outdoor theatre in the wild Bernhardstal gorge, honoring Anna Stainer-Knittel.

1431.name: Gepatsch Reservoir Kaunertal
1431.kurzbeschreibung: The Gepatsch Reservoir at 1,765 m in the Kaunertal: One of Austria's largest embankment dams, set against rugged 3,000-metre peaks along the glacier road.

1432.name: Gerlossteinbahn
1432.kurzbeschreibung: The Gerlossteinbahn cable car at Hainzenberg in the Zillertal ascends to the sunny Gerlosstein plateau at 1,644 metres, featuring alpine meadows and the Almflieger zipline.

1433.name: gieringer-weiher-reith-kitzbuehel
1433.kurzbeschreibung: Gieringer Weiher in the Bichlach protected landscape area near Reith is a dreamy moor lake for nature lovers seeking serenity.

1434.name: Kisslinger Glassworks Rattenberg
1434.kurzbeschreibung: The Schauglashütte Kisslinger in Rattenberg: rich glassmaking tradition across 1,000 m², glowing furnaces, glassblowing demonstrations, and engraving.

1435.name: glashuette-riedel-kufstein-sinnfonie
1435.kurzbeschreibung: The Riedel Glashütte in Kufstein offers a multimedia experience and artisanal glassmaking craftsmanship with the Sinnfonie.

1436.name: Gleirschklamm
1436.kurzbeschreibung: The Gleirschklamm gorge near Scharnitz in the Karwendel Nature Park: primeval gorge trail along the roaring Gleirschbach stream with wooden walkways and a history of timber rafting.

1437.name: Gleirschklamm Gorge Scharnitz
1437.kurzbeschreibung: The Gleirschklamm in the Naturpark Karwendel near Scharnitz: pristine wilderness, emerald-green whitewater, and narrow wooden walkways along the cliff.

1438.name: Gletscherweg Kaunertal
1438.kurzbeschreibung: The Kaunertal Glacier Trail in the rear Kaunertal is a gripping high-alpine educational trail at Gepatschferner glacier above 1,900 m, showcasing moraines and glacial geology.

1439.name: Glungezer
1439.kurzbeschreibung: The Glungezer at 2,677 m above sea level near Tulfes: panoramic mountain in the Tux Alps with a 10-person gondola, Kugelwald (Ball Forest) on the Glungezer, and Zirbenweg (Stone Pine Path).

1440.name: Glungezerbahn Tulfes
1440.kurzbeschreibung: The modern 10-seater gondola lift up the Glungezer near Tulfes: panoramic mountain in the Tuxer Alpen, Kugelwald am Glungezer, and starting point of the Zirbenweg.

1441.name: glungezerbahn-tulfes-kugelwald-bergbahn
1441.kurzbeschreibung: The Glungezerbahn in Tulfes opens up Mount Glungezer and the Kugelwald, the world's largest outdoor wooden ball track.

1442.name: Goldenes Dachl
1442.kurzbeschreibung: The Golden Roof in Innsbruck's historic old town is Tyrol's golden landmark: 2,657 fire-gilded copper tiles, sculpted reliefs, and Emperor Maximilian's museum.

1443.name: golfclub-achensee-pertisau
1443.kurzbeschreibung: Golfclub Achensee in Pertisau is the oldest golf club in Tirol, delighting players with its 18-hole course set against the Karwendelgebirge.

1444.name: golfclub-kitzbuehel-schwarzsee-reith
1444.kurzbeschreibung: Golfclub Kitzbühel-Schwarzsee-Reith offers an outstanding 18-hole course with panoramic views of the Wilder Kaiser.

1445.name: golfclub-seefeld-wildmoos-alpenperle
1445.kurzbeschreibung: Golfclub Seefeld-Wildmoos is a high-alpine gem belonging to the Leading Golf Courses of Austria at nearly 1,300 metres above sea level.

1446.name: golfclub-zillertal-uderns
1446.kurzbeschreibung: Golfclub Zillertal in Uderns inspires golfers with a modern 18-hole championship course, expansive lakes, and an island green.

1447.name: golfpark-mieminger-plateau
1447.kurzbeschreibung: Golfpark Mieminger Plateau impresses with its 27-hole facility on a sun-drenched plateau at the foot of the Mieminger Kette.

1448.name: Glockenmuseum Grassmayr Innsbruck
1448.kurzbeschreibung: The Grassmayr Bell Museum in Innsbruck: Over 400 years of bell-founding heritage, active foundry, interactive sound room, and world-class museum.

1449.name: Grawa-Wasserfall
1449.kurzbeschreibung: The Grawa Waterfall in Neustift im Stubaital: At 85m, the widest waterfall in the Eastern Alps, with a 180m drop, the WildeWasserWeg, and healing spray inhalation.

1450.name: grawa-wasserfall-stubaital
1450.kurzbeschreibung: The Grawa-Wasserfall in the rear Stubaital is the widest waterfall in the Eastern Alps at 85 metres and a designated natural monument.

1451.name: Greifvogelpark Umhausen
1451.kurzbeschreibung: The Umhausen Birds of Prey Park in Ötztal: 5,000 m² open-air arena at Stuibenfall with 30 birds of prey, spectacular flight shows, and a falconry educational trail.

1452.name: Großglockner Hochalpenstraße
1452.kurzbeschreibung: The Grossglockner High Alpine Road is Austria's most iconic scenic highway: 48 km of alpine wonder, Kaiser-Franz-Josefs-Höhe, and the Pasterze Glacier.

1453.name: Kaiser-Franz-Josefs-Höhe at the Grossglockner
1453.kurzbeschreibung: The Kaiser-Franz-Josefs-Höhe at 2,369 m on the Großglockner: majestic views of Austria's highest peak, the Pasterzen glacier, and a visitor center.

1454.name: Hafelekar & Top of Innsbruck
1454.kurzbeschreibung: The Hafelekar at 2,334 m above sea level – Top of Innsbruck: from the historic old town to the summit of the Nordkette in just 30 minutes with 360° views of Karwendel and Inntal.

1455.name: Hahnenkamm
1455.kurzbeschreibung: Kitzbühel's Hahnenkamm is the legendary home of the downhill Streif race and a sunny panoramic hiking mountain in summer.

1456.name: Hahnenkamm Reutte
1456.kurzbeschreibung: The Hahnenkamm mountain near Reutte features a modern cable car, barrier-free alpine flower garden, and 360-degree views over the Außerfern region.

1457.name: hahnenkammbahn-kitzbuehel
1457.kurzbeschreibung: The tradition-steeped Hahnenkammbahn leads up to the legendary Hahnenkamm, the starting point of the world-famous Streif race.

1458.name: Haldensee
1458.kurzbeschreibung: Lake Haldensee at 1,124 m above sea level in the Tannheimer Tal: crystal-clear mountain and swimming lake between Grän and Nesselwängle with the Haldensee Water World leisure facility.

1459.name: haldensee-tannheimer-tal
1459.kurzbeschreibung: Haldensee is a crystal-clear natural swimming lake in the Tannheimer Tal, combining bathing enjoyment with panoramic hikes.

1460.name: Hall in Tirol Altstadt
1460.kurzbeschreibung: The historic old town of Hall in Tyrol enchants as Western Austria's largest medieval ensemble, featuring Hasegg Castle, Mint Tower, and salt-trading alleys.

1461.name: Haus der Musik Innsbruck
1461.kurzbeschreibung: The Haus der Musik Innsbruck on Rennweg: Tyrol's premier cultural center for concerts, theater, university music studies, and high-caliber acoustic arts.

1462.name: Hechtsee
1462.kurzbeschreibung: Lake Hechtsee near Kufstein is a scenic alpine woodland swimming lake up to 57 m deep, nestled beneath the Thierberg ridge with a circular promenade and mountain vistas.

1463.name: Heimatmuseum Kufstein
1463.kurzbeschreibung: The local history museum inside Kufstein Fortress's Bürgerturm exhibits civic culture, guild crafts, Kaisergebirge geology, and historic weaponry.

1464.name: Lake Heiterwanger See & Lake Plansee
1464.kurzbeschreibung: The Heiterwanger See near Reutte: fjord-like mountain lake at 976 m with crystal-clear water, passenger boat cruises, and a canal connecting to Plansee.

1465.name: Heiterwangsee
1465.kurzbeschreibung: Lake Heiterwanger See at 976 metres near Reutte is a fjord-like mountain lake featuring crystalline waters, historic passenger boats, and a canal connecting to Lake Plansee.

1466.name: Helblinghaus Innsbruck
1466.kurzbeschreibung: The Helblinghaus in Innsbruck's Old Town: a late Gothic burgher house from the 15th century with a world-famous, opulent Rococo stucco facade by Anton Gigl from 1732.

1467.name: Hexenwasser Söll Hohe Salve
1467.kurzbeschreibung: Hexenwasser in Söll: Tyrol's oldest and multi-award-winning mountain adventure park at 1,150 m with barefoot trail, bee house, and witchcraft stations.

1468.name: hexenwasser-soell-hohe-salve
1468.kurzbeschreibung: The Hexenwasser in Söll on the Hohe Salve is an award-winning alpine adventure world focusing on water, nature, and the senses.

1469.name: hexenwasser-soell-hohe-salve-erlebnis
1469.kurzbeschreibung: Hexenwasser in Söll enchants families with over 60 adventure stations, a barefoot trail, water features, and a witches' forest on Hohe Salve.

1470.name: highline179-haengebruecke-reutte
1470.kurzbeschreibung: The highline179 near Reutte spans across the valley at 406 meters in length and 114 meters in height as a thrilling suspension bridge.

1471.name: Hintersteiner See
1471.kurzbeschreibung: Lake Hintersteiner See at 882 metres near Scheffau is celebrated as one of Tirol's cleanest alpine lakes, set in the Wilder Kaiser nature reserve with a panoramic circuit.

1472.name: hintersteiner-see-scheffau-tirol
1472.kurzbeschreibung: The Hintersteiner See above Scheffau is a crystal-clear mountain lake situated in the nature reserve of the Wilder Kaiser.

1473.name: Hintertuxer Gletscher
1473.kurzbeschreibung: Austria's only year-round ski resort offers 365 days of snow sports up to 3,250 m, the Nature Ice Palace, and Spannagel Cave.

1474.name: hintertuxer-gletscher-natur-eis-palast
1474.kurzbeschreibung: The Natur Eis Palast at the Hintertuxer Gletscher takes visitors deep inside a natural glacial crevasse featuring an ice lake and sparkling ice crystals.

1475.name: Hochgurgl
1475.kurzbeschreibung: High-altitude Hochgurgl (2,150 m) boasts snow security, the Top Mountain Crosspoint museum, and entry to the Timmelsjoch pass road.

1476.name: Hochstein
1476.kurzbeschreibung: Mount Hochstein (2,057 m) is Lienz's versatile local adventure mountain in East Tirol, featuring the Schlossbergbahn lifts, the Osttirodler alpine coaster, and Dolomite views.

1477.name: Hochzeiger Bergbahnen
1477.kurzbeschreibung: The Hochzeiger Bergbahnen in Jerzens in the Pitztal Valley access a family alpine paradise up to 2,560 m, home to the award-winning Stone Pine Park and mountain carts.

1478.name: Hofburg Innsbruck
1478.kurzbeschreibung: The Imperial Hofburg in Innsbruck enchants as a Habsburg palace featuring the monumental Giant's Hall, Empress Sisi's apartments, and Rococo splendor.

1479.name: Hofgarten Innsbruck
1479.kurzbeschreibung: The Hofgarten in Innsbruck: A ten-hectare protected heritage landscape garden beside the Old Town, featuring centuries-old trees and a historic palm house.

1480.name: Hofkirche Innsbruck
1480.kurzbeschreibung: Innsbruck's Court Church fascinates as the 'Black Men Church' with Emperor Maximilian I's monumental cenotaph and 28 larger-than-life bronze statues.

1481.name: hofkirche-innsbruck-schwarz-mander
1481.kurzbeschreibung: The Hofkirche Innsbruck houses the world-famous Renaissance cenotaph of Kaiser Maximilian I. with 28 larger-than-life bronze statues.

1482.name: Hohe Mut Bahn Obergurgl
1482.kurzbeschreibung: The Hohe Mut Bahn in Obergurgl at 2,670 m: spectacular viewing platform with 360-degree views of 21 three-thousand-metre peaks and the Gurgler glacier expanse.

1483.name: Hohe Salve
1483.kurzbeschreibung: The Hohe Salve at 1,828 m above sea level in the Kitzbühel Alps: Tyrol's most beautiful panoramic mountain with the Salvenkirchlein chapel, a revolving panoramic terrace, and views of 70 three-thousanders.

1484.name: hohe-salve-hopfgarten-aussichtsberg
1484.kurzbeschreibung: At 1,829 metres, Hohe Salve near Hopfgarten offers a magnificent 360-degree panorama of over 70 three-thousand-metre peaks and the Salvenkirchlein.

1485.name: hornbahn-kitzbuehel
1485.kurzbeschreibung: The Kitzbüheler Hornbahn comfortably transports mountain enthusiasts to the striking Kitzbüheler Horn, featuring fascinating views and an alpine flower garden.

1486.name: Hungerburgbahn Innsbruck
1486.kurzbeschreibung: The Hungerburg Funicular in Innsbruck: Zaha Hadid's architectural masterpiece linking the historic city centre to the Hungerburg plateau in eight minutes.

1487.name: hungerburgbahn-innsbruck-nordkette-stationen
1487.kurzbeschreibung: The Hungerburgbahn in Innsbruck connects the old town and the Nordkette with futuristic architecture by star architect Zaha Hadid.

1488.name: ice-q-gourmetrestaurant-soelden
1488.kurzbeschreibung: The futuristic gourmet restaurant ice Q on the summit of the Gaislachkogel in Sölden is world-famous as a James Bond filming location.

1489.name: innsbrucker-dom-st-jakob-kathedrale
1489.kurzbeschreibung: The Innsbrucker Dom St. Jakob is a magnificent Baroque cathedral featuring the famous miraculous image of Maria Hilf by Lucas Cranach.

1490.name: Innsbruck Nordkette Cable Railways & Top of Innsbruck
1490.kurzbeschreibung: The Innsbrucker Nordkettenbahnen: from the old town in 20 minutes to over 2,250 m into the high-alpine Karwendel featuring Zaha Hadid stations and the Top of Innsbruck.

1491.name: innsbrucker-stadtturm-panoramablick
1491.kurzbeschreibung: The gothic Stadtturm Innsbruck offers a breathtaking panoramic view over the historic old town and the mountains after 133 steps.

1492.name: Ischgl
1492.kurzbeschreibung: World-renowned winter and summer lifestyle resort Ischgl in the Paznaun thrills with the Silvretta Arena, Idalp, and Ischgl Skyfly.

1493.name: Iseltal
1493.kurzbeschreibung: The Iseltal Valley in East Tirol is shaped by the Alps' last undammed glacial river, featuring dynamic gravel floodplains, dramatic side valleys, and the famed Iseltrail.

1494.name: Jakobskreuz Buchensteinwand
1494.kurzbeschreibung: The Jakobskreuz (Jacob's Cross) on the 1,456 m high Buchensteinwand in the Pillersee Valley: at 30 m tall, it's the world's largest walkable summit cross with four viewing platforms.

1495.name: Jesuitenkirche Innsbruck zur Heiligen Dreifaltigkeit
1495.kurzbeschreibung: The Early Baroque Jesuit Church in Innsbruck: A monumental domed basilica housing the princely crypt of Archduke Leopold V and the mighty Schützenglocke.

1496.name: Emperor Maximilian Grotto Zirl
1496.kurzbeschreibung: The Kaiser-Maximilian-Grotte in the Martinswand near Zirl: legendary rock cave high above the Inntal with a large crucifix and panoramic views.

1497.name: Kaiserbach Klamm
1497.kurzbeschreibung: The Kaiserbach-Klamm Gorge in the Kaiserbachtal near Kössen and Kirchdorf charms visitors with its cascading mountain brook and dramatic vistas of the Wilder Kaiser crags.

1498.name: kaiserbad-ellmau-erlebnisbad
1498.kurzbeschreibung: KaiserBad Ellmau delights visitors with adventure pools, giant water slides, an organic swimming pond, and a sauna village against the Kaiser backdrop.

1499.name: kaiserjaeger-museum-bergisel-innsbruck
1499.kurzbeschreibung: The Kaiserjägermuseum on the Bergisel in Innsbruck documents the military history of the four Tyrolean Kaiserjäger regiments.

1500.name: Kaiserjägermuseum
1500.kurzbeschreibung: The Kaiserjägermuseum on Bergisel in Innsbruck documents the storied history of Tyrol's imperial rifle regiments with arms, paintings, and banners.

1501.name: Tiroler Kaiserjägermuseum
1501.kurzbeschreibung: The Tyrolean Kaiserjäger Museum on Bergisel in Innsbruck: founded in 1880, one of the oldest military museums worldwide dedicated to the history of the four Imperial and Royal Kaiserjäger regiments.

1502.name: Kaiserklamm
1502.kurzbeschreibung: The Kaiserklamm Gorge near Brandenberg is a wild ravine carved by the Brandenberger Ache, featuring cliff-hewn trails, rushing whitewaters, and timber-drifting heritage.

1503.name: kaiserklamm-brandenberg
1503.kurzbeschreibung: The Kaiserklamm in Brandenberg thrills visitors with roaring waters, deep rocky gorges, and paths boldly carved into the cliff face.

1504.name: kaiserklamm-brandenberg-naturerlebnis
1504.kurzbeschreibung: The Kaiserklamm in Brandenberg is a historic natural monument featuring roaring waterfalls and trails carved straight into the rock.

1505.name: kaiserliche-hofburg-innsbruck-residenz
1505.kurzbeschreibung: The Kaiserliche Hofburg in Innsbruck delights as a magnificent Habsburg residence featuring the Riesensaal and baroque imperial apartments.

1506.name: Kaiserlift Kufstein Naturerlebnis Brentenjoch
1506.kurzbeschreibung: The historic Kaiserlift in Kufstein: nostalgic 1-seater chairlift into the Kaisergebirge nature reserve at 1,256 m with panoramic views and hiking trails.

1507.name: Kalser Glocknerstraße
1507.kurzbeschreibung: The Kalser Glocknerstraße leads to the Lucknerhaus with the most impressive direct view of Austria's highest peak, the Großglockner (3,798 m).

1508.name: Karlskirche Volders
1508.kurzbeschreibung: The Karlskirche Volders near Hall in Tirol: a unique orientalizing Baroque building by Dr. Hippolyt Guarinoni from 1620–1654 with six domes and Knoller frescoes.

1509.name: Karwendelbahn
1509.kurzbeschreibung: The Karwendelbahn cable car ascends from Mittenwald to 2,244 m on the Karwendelspitze, featuring a giant telescope visitor centre, panoramic paths, and Dammkar vistas.

1510.name: Kaunertaler Gletscher
1510.kurzbeschreibung: The Kaunertal Glacier up to 3,108 m on the Weißseeferner ice sheet offers an alpine wonderland featuring the barrier-free Falginjochbahn lift, a walk-in ice crevasse, and tri-border vistas.

1511.name: Kaunertaler Gletscherstraße
1511.kurzbeschreibung: The Kaunertal Glacier Road is one of the Alps' premier high-altitude drives: 26 km, 29 hairpin turns, ascending from 1,287 m to 2,750 m past the turquoise Gepatsch Reservoir.

1512.name: kaunertaler-gletscherstrasse-panoramaweg
1512.kurzbeschreibung: The Kaunertaler Gletscherstrasse winds through 29 hairpin bends past the Gepatsch-Stausee reservoir directly to the edge of eternal ice.

1513.name: Kellerjochbahn Schwaz
1513.kurzbeschreibung: The Kellerjochbahn near Schwaz: chairlifts to the scenic Kellerjoch at 1,887 m above sea level with the Kellerjochkapelle and 360-degree Inntal views.

1514.name: Kisslinger Kristallglas Rattenberg
1514.kurzbeschreibung: The Kisslinger Kristallglas show glassworks in Rattenberg: centuries-old glassblowing craftsmanship, grinding, engraving, and sparkling glass art.

1515.name: Kitzbüheler Altstadt
1515.kurzbeschreibung: The historic old town of Kitzbühel delights with colorful gabled merchant homes, upscale boutiques, medieval city wall remains, and alpine flair.

1516.name: Kitzbüheler Horn
1516.kurzbeschreibung: The Kitzbüheler Horn (1,996 m) is Kitzbühel's iconic panoramic mountain, celebrated for the KitzSki gondolas, the Alpine Flower Garden, and 360-degree vistas of the Wilder Kaiser.

1517.name: Wallfahrtskloster Maria Waldrast
1517.kurzbeschreibung: Maria Waldrast at 1,638 m at the foot of the Serles: Central Europe's highest monastery, Servite pilgrimage site since 1407, and legendary healing spring.

1518.name: Knappenwelt Gurgltal Tarrenz
1518.kurzbeschreibung: The Gurgltal Mining World in Tarrenz: authentically reconstructed 15th-century historical mining village with ore processing and a healer's garden.

1519.name: Krimml Waterfalls
1519.kurzbeschreibung: The Krimmler Wasserfälle at the Gerlospass: with a 380 m drop the highest waterfalls in Europe, spectacular waterfall trail, and certified healing power.

1520.name: krimmler-wasserfallweg-hohe-tauern
1520.kurzbeschreibung: The Krimmler Wasserfallweg leads along the three tiers of Europe's largest waterfalls via secure viewing platforms.

1521.name: krimmler-wasserwelten-wasserfallzentrum
1521.kurzbeschreibung: The Krimmler Wasserwelten combine a modern science museum and an energetic aquapark at the foot of the gigantic Krimmler Wasserfaelle.

1522.name: Krippenmuseum Stamserhaus Wenns
1522.kurzbeschreibung: The Nativity Museum in the historic Stamserhaus in Wenns: the oldest farmhouse in the Pitztal valley (15th century) with over 40 valuable Tyrolean Christmas cribs.

1523.name: Krippenmuseum Wildermieming
1523.kurzbeschreibung: The Nativity Museum in Wildermieming on the sunny plateau: over 50 artistic Tyrolean and oriental Christmas cribs by master carvers.

1524.name: Kugelwald Wooden Marble Run Glungezer Tulfes
1524.kurzbeschreibung: Kugelwald am Glungezer near Tulfes: the world's largest wooden marble run in a stone pine forest at 1,560 m with spectacular tracks, treehouse, and relaxation areas.

1525.name: Kundler Klamm
1525.kurzbeschreibung: Kundler Klamm enchants as an accessible natural gorge between Kundl and Wildschönau featuring rushing waters, soaring cliffs, and Tyrolean marble.

1526.name: Kundl Gorge Kundler Klamm
1526.kurzbeschreibung: The Kundler Klamm: a family-friendly natural gorge between Kundl and the Wildschönau featuring the roaring Wildschönauer Ache and a slow train.

1527.name: kundler-klamm-wildschoenau-inntal
1527.kurzbeschreibung: The Kundler Klamm connects the Wildschönau with the Inntal via an idyllic, stroller-friendly rocky path alongside a roaring torrent.

1528.name: Lanser See
1528.kurzbeschreibung: Lake Lanser See at 836 m on the Innsbruck plateau is a heritage peat-water bathing tarn featuring healing moor mud, a vintage lido, walking loops, and Nordkette views.

1529.name: lanser-see-innsbruck-suedliches-mittelgebirge
1529.kurzbeschreibung: Lanser See on the southern Mittelgebirge plateau near Innsbruck is a traditional moor lake with healing waters and water lilies.

1530.name: Lechfall
1530.kurzbeschreibung: The Lechfall Waterfall at the threshold of the Lech Gorge near Füssen and Reutte features a twelve-metre cascade where the wild River Lech plunges into a narrow canyon.

1531.name: Lechweg
1531.kurzbeschreibung: The alpine opening section of the Lechweg on the Arlberg leads from Lake Formarinsee at 1,793 m beneath the Rote Wand through pristine gorges and Walser hamlets to Steeg.

1532.name: Lechweg Wanderweg
1532.kurzbeschreibung: The Lechweg through the Tyrolean Außerfern: long-distance trekking along the wild Lech river, across the 200 m Holzgau suspension bridge, to the Lechfall in Füssen.

1533.name: leutascher-geisterklamm-mittenwald
1533.kurzbeschreibung: The Leutascher Geisterklamm fascinates visitors with an 800-metre-long cliff walkway, a daring panoramic bridge, and the legend of the gorge spirit.

1534.name: Leutascher Geisterklamm
1534.kurzbeschreibung: The Leutasch Spirit Gorge: spectacular rocky gorge on the border with Bavaria with a 970 m steel walkway, daring panoramic bridge, and goblin trail.

1535.name: Lake Lichtsee Obernberg am Brenner
1535.kurzbeschreibung: Lichtsee at 2,101 m in the Obernbergtal: crystal-clear high-alpine lake with world-famous reflections of the mighty Obernberger Tribulaun.

1536.name: Liebfrauenkirche Kitzbühel
1536.kurzbeschreibung: The historic Liebfrauenkirche on Kitzbühel's church hill features a massive bell tower, the famous six-ton Kaiser Bell, and an ornate baroque high altar.

1537.name: Lienzer Altstadt
1537.kurzbeschreibung: The sun-drenched old town of Lienz enchants as the jewel of East Tyrol with southern charm, vibrant townhouses, Liebburg castle, and Dolomite views.

1538.name: Lienzer Dolomiten
1538.kurzbeschreibung: The rugged Lienz Dolomites enchant mountaineers with pale limestone pinnacles, the Karlsbader Hütte on Lake Laserzsee, and via ferratas.

1539.name: Localbahnmuseum Innsbruck (Tiroler Museumsbahnen)
1539.kurzbeschreibung: The Localbahn Museum in the old Stubaital train station in Innsbruck: historic trams, locomotives, and Tyrolean railway history since 1891.

1540.name: Martinswand
1540.kurzbeschreibung: The vertical Martinswand cliff near Zirl impresses with Emperor Maximilian's historic grotto, celebrated via ferratas, and wide Inn Valley vistas.

1541.name: moeserer-see-telfs-seefeld
1541.kurzbeschreibung: Möserer See on the Seefeld plateau is an idyllic forest lake and ranks among the warmest bathing lakes in Tirol.

1542.name: Mondscheinspitze
1542.kurzbeschreibung: The striking Mondscheinspitze (2,106 m) in the Karwendel rewards surefooted mountain hikers with unforgettable vistas over emerald Lake Achensee.

1543.name: moorbad-flirsch-arlberg
1543.kurzbeschreibung: Moorbad Flirsch in the Stanzer Tal is a soothing natural moor bath with Kneipp facilities and stunning mountain scenery.

1544.name: Hall Mint & Hasegg Castle Hall in Tirol
1544.kurzbeschreibung: Münze Hall at Burg Hasegg: birthplace of the thaler and the modern dollar featuring the roller minting press, Münzerturm tower, and town history.

1545.name: Murmliwasser & Murmlitrail Serfaus
1545.kurzbeschreibung: The Murmliwasser at the Komperdellbahn in Serfaus at 1,980 m: 15,000 m² water adventure park featuring a marmot enclosure, gold panning site, and the Murmlitrail.

1546.name: Museum im Ballhaus Imst
1546.kurzbeschreibung: The Museum in the Ballhaus in Imst: historical 16th-century grain and bale storage with Imst town history, sacred art, and the famous Schemenlaufen carnival.

1547.name: Museum der Völker Schwaz
1547.kurzbeschreibung: The Museum der Völker in Schwaz: Western Austria's unique ethnographic museum featuring masterpieces of African and Asian tribal art.

1548.name: Museumsfriedhof Kramsach
1548.kurzbeschreibung: The Kramsach Museum Cemetery ("Merry Cemetery"): a unique open-air museum for quirky, humorous grave inscriptions and wrought-iron art spanning five centuries.

1549.name: Museum Grünes Haus
1549.kurzbeschreibung: The Museum Grünes Haus in Reutte features striking green trompe-l'œil facade frescoes, baroque Zeiller religious art, and regional Außerfern cultural history.

1550.name: Museum Kitzbühel
1550.kurzbeschreibung: The Museum Kitzbühel at Hinterstadt 32 showcases over 60 original paintings by Alfons Walde, 3,000 years of mining history, and scenic rooftop views.

1551.name: Museum Kitzbühel – Sammlung Alfons Walde
1551.kurzbeschreibung: The Museum Kitzbühel in the medieval granary: the world's largest collection of masterpieces by Alfons Walde, ski history, and civic heritage.

1552.name: Museum St. Anton am Arlberg
1552.kurzbeschreibung: The Museum St. Anton am Arlberg inside the historic Trier House showcases the birthplace of alpine skiing and early Arlberg railway history.

1553.name: Museum St. Johann in Tirol
1553.kurzbeschreibung: The Museum St. Johann in Tirol: regional history, alpinism on the Wilder Kaiser, Artothek gallery, and geology of the Kitzbühel Alps.

1554.name: Museum Tiroler Bauernhöfe
1554.kurzbeschreibung: Museum of Tyrolean Farmhouses in Kramsach: Tyrol's largest open-air museum with 14 original farmhouses and 37 outbuildings from all parts of the region, spread over 8 hectares.

1555.name: museum-tiroler-bauernhoefe-kramsach-freilicht
1555.kurzbeschreibung: The open-air Museum Tiroler Bauernhöfe in Kramsach invites visitors on an atmospheric journey back in time through 14 historic Tyrolean farmhouses.

1556.name: Museum der Wahrnehmung
1556.kurzbeschreibung: The interactive sensory exhibition in Sölden fascinates visitors with hands-on perception experiments, optical illusions, and alpine high-altitude science.

1557.name: Museum Wattens Industrie & Vorgeschichte
1557.kurzbeschreibung: Museum Wattens: A captivating synthesis of 2,500 years of settlement history at Himmelreich, Daniel Swarovski, and modern industrial heritage.

1558.name: Muttekopf
1558.kurzbeschreibung: The Muttekopf (2,774 m) in the Lechtal Alps lures alpinists with the Imst Via Ferrata, the historic Muttekopfhütte, and views stretching to the Zugspitze.

1559.name: Muttereralmbahn Mutters
1559.kurzbeschreibung: The Muttereralmbahn in Mutters: family adventure mountain at 1,608 m above sea level with a mountain cart track, adventure playground, and panoramic lake.

1560.name: Nationalpark Hohe Tauern
1560.kurzbeschreibung: Hohe Tauern National Park is the largest nature reserve in the Alps: 3,000 m giants, the Pasterze Glacier, thunderous cascades, and alpine ibex.

1561.name: Nationalparkhaus Matrei
1561.kurzbeschreibung: The National Park Centre in Matrei in East Tyrol showcases the Tauern Worlds exhibition with interactive insights into alpine flora, fauna, and glaciers.

1562.name: natterer-see-erlebnisoase-natters
1562.kurzbeschreibung: Natterer See near Innsbruck combines a picturesque moor lake with an action-packed water adventure park.

1563.name: Nature Ice Palace Hintertux Glacier
1563.kurzbeschreibung: The Natur Eis Palast at Hintertuxer Gletscher at 3,250 m: a globally unique ice cave deep inside glacier ice with a frozen lake and boat tour.

1564.name: Naturpark Kaunergrat
1564.kurzbeschreibung: Naturpark Kaunergrat enchants with the protected Piller Moor peat bog, the modern Naturparkhaus at Gachenblick, and the towering Wildspitze peak.

1565.name: Naturpark Zillertaler Alpen
1565.kurzbeschreibung: The High Mountain Nature Park Zillertal Alps features over 80 glaciers, pristine side valleys, the mountaineering village of Ginzling, and immense biodiversity.

1566.name: naturparkhaus-tiroler-lech-klimmbruecke
1566.kurzbeschreibung: The Naturparkhaus on the Klimmbrücke in Elmen hovers directly above the Lech and showcases the last wild river of the Northern Alps.

1567.name: Nauders Dreiländereck
1567.kurzbeschreibung: The Tripoint near Nauders on the Reschen Pass unites the borders of Austria, Italy, and Switzerland into a scenic alpine crossroads steeped in history and sweeping views.

1568.name: Nordkette
1568.kurzbeschreibung: The Innsbruck Nordkette merges urban sophistication with rugged high mountains: Zaha Hadid's Hungerburgbahn, Seegrube, and Hafelekar at 2,269 meters.

1569.name: nordkette-seegrube-hafelekar-innsbruck
1569.kurzbeschreibung: The Nordkettenbahnen lead up to the Seegrube and the 2,334-meter-high Hafelekar, offering the famous 360-degree Top of Innsbruck panorama.

1570.name: Notburga-Museum Eben am Achensee
1570.kurzbeschreibung: The Notburga Museum in Eben am Achensee: the only museum honoring Tyrol's most beloved folk saint, Notburga of Rattenberg, in the baroque rectory from 2004.

1571.name: Obernberger See
1571.kurzbeschreibung: Obernberger See at 1,590 m in the Wipptal: emerald-green natural gem at the foot of the Tribulaun, featuring the baroque Seekapelle Maria am See on a peninsula.

1572.name: obernberger-see-wipptal
1572.kurzbeschreibung: The Obernberger See in the Wipptal is an idyllic mountain lake with an island chapel beneath the rugged rock faces of the Tribulaun.

1573.name: Bergbahnen Oberperfuss Rangger Köpfl
1573.kurzbeschreibung: The Bergbahnen Oberperfuss to the Rangger Köpfl: 8-seater gondola, Geisterwanderweg for families, panoramic lake, and sweeping views of the Inntal.

1574.name: Ötzi Dorf
1574.kurzbeschreibung: The Ötzi Village in Umhausen is an archaeological open-air park depicting everyday life, housing, and survival during the Neolithic era of the Iceman.

1575.name: oetzi-dorf-archaeologischer-park-umhausen
1575.kurzbeschreibung: The Ötzi-Dorf in Umhausen is an archaeological open-air park that brings life in the Stone Age vividly to life.

1576.name: oetzi-dorf-umhausen-archaeologie
1576.kurzbeschreibung: The Ötzi-Dorf in Umhausen is an archaeological park showcasing the fascinating daily life and crafts of people during the era of Ötzi the Iceman.

1577.name: Ötztaler Heimat- und Freilichtmuseum Längenfeld
1577.kurzbeschreibung: The Ötztaler Heimat- und Freilichtmuseum in Längenfeld-Lehn: 15 historic buildings from the 17th to the 20th century showcase alpine mountain farming culture.

1578.name: Ötztaler Höhenstraße
1578.kurzbeschreibung: The Ötztal High Mountain and Glacier Road reaches the Rettenbach and Tiefenbach glaciers: the highest paved road pass in the Eastern Alps at 2,830 meters.

1579.name: Olympiaworld Innsbruck
1579.kurzbeschreibung: Olympiaworld Innsbruck: Legendary sports and entertainment arena host of two Winter Olympic Games, featuring premier ice rinks and the Tivoli stadium.

1580.name: Ottoburg Innsbruck
1580.kurzbeschreibung: The historic Ottoburg at the entrance to Innsbruck's Old Town: A 15th-century Late Gothic fortified tower featuring oriel windows and fine dining.

1581.name: panorama-badewelt-st-johann-tirol
1581.kurzbeschreibung: The Panorama Badewelt in St. Johann in Tirol delights visitors with an indoor pool, outdoor pool, giant slides, and a large sauna landscape.

1582.name: Pass Thurn
1582.kurzbeschreibung: Pass Thurn (1,274 m) links Kitzbühel with Salzburg's Pinzgau: protected Wasenmoos bog, sweeping mountain views, and hiking paradise.

1583.name: Patscherkofel
1583.kurzbeschreibung: Patscherkofel (2,248 m) is Innsbruck's iconic landmark mountain: modern 10-seater gondola, historic stone pine path (Zirbenweg), and Olympic runs.

1584.name: Patscherkofel Cable Car Innsbruck-Igls
1584.kurzbeschreibung: The Patscherkofelbahn in Innsbruck-Igls: a modern 10-passenger gondola to Innsbruck's iconic local mountain at 1,965 m featuring the Zirbenweg and Olympic heritage.

1585.name: Penken-Joch
1585.kurzbeschreibung: Penkenjoch in the Zillertal impresses with the modern 3S Penkenbahn, Mario Botta's futuristic Granatkapelle, and watersports at the reservoir.

1586.name: penkenbahn-mayrhofen
1586.kurzbeschreibung: The modern Penkenbahn connects Mayrhofen with the action mountain Penken, a hotspot for hikers, mountain bikers, and climbing fans.

1587.name: Pfarrkirche St. Andreas
1587.kurzbeschreibung: The late-Gothic Saint Andreas Parish Church in Kitzbühel showcases magnificent baroque altars, ceiling frescoes, and the adjoining historic Liebfrauen Bell Tower.

1588.name: Pfarrkirche St. Jakob am Arlberg
1588.kurzbeschreibung: The baroque Saint Jakob Parish Church is the oldest parish in the Arlberg region and a traditional spiritual milestone on the Tyrolean Way of Saint James.

1589.name: Pfrillsee Kufstein
1589.kurzbeschreibung: Pfrillsee near Kufstein is the smallest and most secluded of Kufstein's forest lakes: a peaty natural gem, peaceful retreat, and water lily haven.

1590.name: Piburger See
1590.kurzbeschreibung: Piburger See above Oetz is Tirol's warmest mountain bathing lake, set in an idyllic protected nature reserve framed by dense coniferous forest.

1591.name: piburger-see-oetz-tirol
1591.kurzbeschreibung: Piburger See above Oetz is one of the warmest swimming lakes in Tirol, boasting an idyllic woodland setting.

1592.name: Pillersee
1592.kurzbeschreibung: The Pillersee in St. Ulrich at 835 m altitude: emerald-green mountain lake in the Pillerseetal, circular trail, stand-up paddling, and backdrop of the Loferer Steinberge.

1593.name: pillersee-st-ulrich-tirol
1593.kurzbeschreibung: Pillersee in St. Ulrich is the emerald-green heart of the Pillerseetal, framed by the rugged Loferer Steinberge.

1594.name: Pitztaler Gletscher
1594.kurzbeschreibung: The Pitztal Glacier is Tyrol's rooftop: Wildspitzbahn to Café 3440 at 3,440 meters, eternal ice, and panoramas over 50 three-thousand-meter peaks.

1595.name: Zeiss Planetarium Schwaz
1595.kurzbeschreibung: The Zeiss Planetarium in Schwaz: Western Austria's most modern fulldome dome cinema with digital star simulations and captivating journeys into space.

1596.name: Plansee
1596.kurzbeschreibung: Lake Plansee near Reutte is Tirol's second-largest lake—a fjord-like alpine wonderland boasting emerald water, scenic passenger cruises, and pebble beaches.

1597.name: plansee-reutte-breitenwang-tirol
1597.kurzbeschreibung: The Plansee near Reutte is Tyrol's second-largest lake and fascinates with its fjord-like mountain backdrop and boat cruises.

1598.name: Rundfunk- und Radiomuseum Innsbruck
1598.kurzbeschreibung: The Radiomuseum in Innsbruck: a fascinating journey through 100 years of broadcasting technology featuring over 400 operational historic radios and phonographs.

1599.name: Ramsbergbahn Ramsau in the Zillertal
1599.kurzbeschreibung: The traditional Ramsbergbahn near Ramsau im Zillertal: leisurely single-seater chairlift up the Ramsberg to 1,300 m with magnificent views of the Zillertal.

1600.name: Lake Reintaler See Kramsach
1600.kurzbeschreibung: The Reintaler See in Kramsach: warmest swimming lake in Tyrol at up to 25 °C, featuring sunbathing lawns, boat rentals, a circular trail, and lakeside restaurants.

1601.name: reither-see-alpbachtal
1601.kurzbeschreibung: Reither See in the heart of Reith im Alpbachtal offers a wonderfully situated family lido with panoramic views.

1602.name: Riedel Glas Manufaktur
1602.kurzbeschreibung: The Riedel Glass factory in Kufstein showcases the art of mouth-blown crystal glassware and the multisensory Sinnfonie exhibition.

1603.name: Riesenrundgemälde
1603.kurzbeschreibung: The Innsbruck Giant Panoramic Painting at Bergisel captivates visitors with a monumental 360-degree panoramic depiction of the 1809 Tyrolean battles for freedom.

1604.name: Lake Rifflsee Pitztal
1604.kurzbeschreibung: Lake Rifflsee at 2,232 m in the upper Pitztal: Tyrol's largest natural high-alpine lake, famous for scenic raft cruises framed by majestic glacier peaks.

1605.name: Römermuseum Aguntum
1605.kurzbeschreibung: The Aguntum Museum near Dölsach in East Tyrol unveils Tyrol's only Roman city with extensive open-air excavations, luxury atrium house, and viewing tower.

1606.name: Römerweg Kitzbühel
1606.kurzbeschreibung: The Roman Way (Römerweg) links Kitzbühel with St. Johann in Tirol, tracing an ancient trade path past historic heritage farmsteads with Kaiser mountain vistas.

1607.name: Rofanplateau
1607.kurzbeschreibung: The Rofan Plateau above Lake Achensee delights with the Rofanseilbahn cable car, the Airrofan skyglider, and scenic ridge hikes to Rofanspitze.

1608.name: Rofanseilbahn
1608.kurzbeschreibung: The Rofanseilbahn cable car in Maurach at Lake Achensee reaches 1,840 m in the Rofan Mountains, featuring the AIRROFAN skyglider, the Adlerhorst viewing nest, and panoramic paths.

1609.name: rofanseilbahn-maurach
1609.kurzbeschreibung: The Rofanseilbahn in Maurach am Achensee opens up the spectacular Rofangebirge with Skyglider and Adlerhorst.

1610.name: Rosengartenschlucht
1610.kurzbeschreibung: The wild Rosengartenschlucht gorge in Imst enchants visitors with roaring waterfalls, wooden walkways, the Blue Grotto, and lush flora.

1611.name: Rosengarten Gorge Imst
1611.kurzbeschreibung: The Rosengartenschlucht in Imst: a geological natural jewel in the heart of the town centre, leading across bridges and stairways up to the Blaue Grotte.

1612.name: rosengartenschlucht-imst-geologie
1612.kurzbeschreibung: The Rosengartenschlucht in Imst leads across wooden footbridges and rock-cut steps along the Schinderbach to the mysterious Blaue Grotte.

1613.name: Ruine Lavant
1613.kurzbeschreibung: The Kirchbichl hill in Lavant is one of the Eastern Alps' most important archaeological sites, featuring late-antique episcopal basilicas and sweeping views.

1614.name: Salvenkirchlein Chapel on the Hohe Salve
1614.kurzbeschreibung: The Salvenkirchlein on the Hohe Salve at 1,829 m: Austria's highest pilgrimage church with a 360-degree panoramic view of over 70 three-thousand-metre peaks.

1615.name: Bergbau- und Salzwelten Hall in Tirol
1615.kurzbeschreibung: The Salzwelten and Mining Museum in Hall in Tirol: A reconstructed salt mine gallery in the historic old town with shafts, tools, and salt history.

1616.name: schlegeis-alpenstrasse-zillertal-staumauer
1616.kurzbeschreibung: The Schlegeis Alpenstrasse leads to the colossal 131-meter-high dam wall of the Schlegeisspeicher, featuring dam tours and a via ferrata.

1617.name: Schlegeis-Staumauer & Stausee
1617.kurzbeschreibung: The Schlegeis-Staumauer dam at 1,782 m in upper Zillertal: 131 m high arch dam, dam interior tours, Flying Fox, and the ' Schlegeis131' via ferrata.

1618.name: Schlegeisspeicher
1618.kurzbeschreibung: Schlegeisspeicher in the upper Zillertal features turquoise waters, a monumental 131 m dam wall, and the famous Olpererhaus suspension bridge.

1619.name: Schloss Ambras
1619.kurzbeschreibung: Renaissance castle Ambras overlooking Innsbruck houses the world's oldest preserved museum collection and the magnificent Spanish Hall.

1620.name: schloss-ambras-innsbruck-residenz
1620.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Ambras Innsbruck captivates visitors as the world's oldest museum with its Spanischer Saal, chambers of wonder, and castle gardens.

1621.name: Schloss Fernsteinsee
1621.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Fernsteinsee on the Fern Pass sits by an emerald mountain lake featuring the Sigmundsburg island fortress, boating, diving depths, and Mieming range vistas.

1622.name: Freundsberg Castle & Museum Schwaz
1622.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Freundsberg in Schwaz: proud hilltop castle dating back to 1170 with a five-story Romanesque keep, castle church, and museum of the silver town.

1623.name: Schloss Itter
1623.kurzbeschreibung: Historic Itter Castle crowns a prominent rocky knoll at the entrance of the Brixental valley and gained worldwide fame for its 1945 battle.

1624.name: Landeck Castle & District Museum
1624.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Landeck on a steep cliff: landmark of the Tiroler Oberland with a Romanesque keep, Gothic chapel, and interactive local history museum.

1625.name: Schloss Lengberg
1625.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Lengberg in Nikolsdorf is an East Tyrolean cultural gem renowned for its Renaissance arcade courtyard and sensational historic textile discoveries.

1626.name: Schloss Lichtenwerth
1626.kurzbeschreibung: The romantic moated fortress Schloss Lichtenwerth near Münster in the lower Inn Valley charms as a privately owned castle jewel amidst pristine riverside wetlands.

1627.name: Lichtenwerth Castle Münster
1627.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Lichtenwerth near Münster in the Inntal: a romantic 12th-century medieval moated castle, idyllically situated on the Inn river.

1628.name: Schloss Matzen
1628.kurzbeschreibung: Picturesque castle near Reith in the Alpbachtal, surrounded by the heritage-listed 15-hectare Matzen Park with tranquil ponds and exotic trees.

1629.name: Schloss Matzen und Schlosspark Reith
1629.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Matzen near Reith im Alpbachtal: fortified 12th-century castle and a heritage-protected, freely accessible English landscape park with lakes.

1630.name: schloss-matzen-reith-tirol-schlosspark
1630.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Matzen near Reith im Alpbachtal delights visitors with its historic castle complex and one of Tyrol's most beautiful English landscape parks.

1631.name: Schloss Mentlberg
1631.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Mentlberg nestled on the outskirts of Innsbruck delights visitors with its fairytale French Loire-inspired architecture and peaceful parklands.

1632.name: schloss-mentlberg-innsbruck
1632.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Mentlberg on the western outskirts of Innsbruck is a romantic fairytale castle built in the French historicist style.

1633.name: Schloss Rotholz Buch in Tirol
1633.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Rotholz in Buch in Tirol: stately 1575 Renaissance hunting lodge built by Archduke Ferdinand II, today the cradle of Tyrolean alpine cheese making.

1634.name: Schloss Starkenberg
1634.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Starkenberg near Tarrenz captivates as a medieval castle housing the Starkenberg Brewery World, beer swimming pools, and scenic trail.

1635.name: Schloss Tratzberg
1635.kurzbeschreibung: Stately Renaissance castle perched above the Inn Valley featuring original state rooms, historic armouries, and award-winning audio drama tours.

1636.name: schloss-tratzberg-renaissance-stans
1636.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Tratzberg between Stans and Jenbach is an outstanding Renaissance jewel boasting fully preserved original furnishings.

1637.name: Tratzberg Castle Stans
1637.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Tratzberg in Stans in the Inntal: late Gothic Renaissance castle from 1500 with the Habsburger-Saal, armory, and interactive children's audio drama tour.

1638.name: Schloss Weiherburg
1638.kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Weiherburg above Innsbruck: a Late Gothic noble manor from 1460, menagerie of Archduke Ferdinand II, St. Anne's castle chapel, and panoramic views of the city.

1639.name: Schwarzsee Kitzbühel
1639.kurzbeschreibung: Lake Schwarzsee near Kitzbühel is a scenic peat-water tarn at 762 m, known as one of the warmest alpine bathing lakes with boat hires, lido, and Wilder Kaiser reflections.

1640.name: schwarzsee-moorbad-kitzbuehel
1640.kurzbeschreibung: Schwarzsee between Kitzbühel and Reith is a warm moor lake offering postcard views of the Wilder Kaiser.

1641.name: Seebensee Ehrwald
1641.kurzbeschreibung: Lake Seebensee at 1,657 m near Ehrwald: A pristine alpine jewel in the Mieming Range with crystal-clear waters framing the mighty Zugspitze massif.

1642.name: Seespitz Achenkirch
1642.kurzbeschreibung: Seespitz Achenkirch on Lake Achensee's northern shore features a sandy bathing lido, shallow swim lagoon, ferry landings, and scenic vistas of Rofan and Karwendel.

1643.name: Serfauser Sauser Action Zipline Serfaus
1643.kurzbeschreibung: The Serfauser Sauser in Serfaus: over 2,000 m long high-alpine zipline in 4 sections reaching up to 65 km/h and flying up to 85 m above the treetops.

1644.name: Silberbergwerk Schwaz
1644.kurzbeschreibung: The 'Mother of all Mines' in Schwaz takes visitors aboard a mine train deep into the medieval silver mountain of Europe's wealthiest mining town.

1645.name: silberbergwerk-schwaz-erlebnis
1645.kurzbeschreibung: The Silberbergwerk Schwaz takes visitors deep into the mountain by mine train to the cradle of European silver mining.

1646.name: Silvretta-Bielerhöhe & Reservoir
1646.kurzbeschreibung: The Silvretta-Bielerhöhe at 2,037 m: Alpine pass between Tyrol and Vorarlberg with the turquoise Silvretta Reservoir facing the iconic Piz Buin (3,312 m).

1647.name: Silvretta Hochalpenstraße
1647.kurzbeschreibung: The Silvretta High Alpine Road negotiates 34 hairpin bends linking Tyrol and Vorarlberg, reaching the 2,037 m Bielerhöhe pass, Lake Silvretta, and Mount Piz Buin views.

1648.name: Sommer-Funpark Fiss
1648.kurzbeschreibung: Sommer-Funpark Fiss at 1,812 m Möseralm: alpine action adventure world featuring Fisser Flitzer, Fisser Flieger, Skyswing, and giant slides.

1649.name: Spannagel Cave at the Hintertux Glacier
1649.kurzbeschreibung: Spannagelhöhle at Hintertuxer Gletscher at 2,521 m: Europe's highest show cave and the largest marble cave in the Central Alps with 13 km of passageways.

1650.name: Spieljoch
1650.kurzbeschreibung: Spieljoch in Fügen is the premier adventure peak in the Zillertal with a 10-seater gondola to 1,865 m, water adventure park, historic copper mine, and panoramas.

1651.name: St. Anton am Arlberg
1651.kurzbeschreibung: St. Anton am Arlberg is the world-renowned cradle of alpine skiing, captivating summer visitors with the Valluga cable car, via ferratas, and Verwall valley.

1652.name: Stadtturm Innsbruck
1652.kurzbeschreibung: The Gothic City Tower in Innsbruck soars above the old town, rewarding climbers with 360-degree views of the Nordkette mountains and golden roof.

1653.name: Stadtturm Rattenberg (Augustiner-Museum)
1653.kurzbeschreibung: The historic church and town tower in Rattenberg: baroque belfry, Augustinian-Servite museum with sacred art treasures, and panoramic views of the Inn.

1654.name: Stausee Zillergründl
1654.kurzbeschreibung: The fjord-like Speicher Zillergründl (1,850 m) in the Zillertal Alps features an imposing 186 m arch dam and the scenic trail to Little Tibet.

1655.name: Steinbockzentrum Tirol St. Leonhard
1655.kurzbeschreibung: The Steinbockzentrum Tirol at Schrofenhof in St. Leonhard im Pitztal: Alpine ibex wildlife enclosure, modern architecture, and the story of resettlement.

1656.name: Stift Stams
1656.kurzbeschreibung: The Cistercian Abbey of Stams in the upper Inn Valley enchants with its opulent baroque collegiate church, Princes' Crypt, Bernardi Hall, and historic monastic culture.

1657.name: stift-stams-zisterzienser-oberland
1657.kurzbeschreibung: The Cistercian Stift Stams in the Oberinntal impresses as a baroque monastery complex with a splendid basilica and princely crypt.

1658.name: Stift Wilten
1658.kurzbeschreibung: Historic Wilten Abbey in Innsbruck impresses as a spiritual centre with sumptuous baroque architecture, monastery traditions, and the famed Wilten Boys' Choir.

1659.name: Wilten Abbey Innsbruck
1659.kurzbeschreibung: The Premonstratensian Abbey of Stift Wilten at the foot of the Bergisel: Baroque monastery jewel founded in 1138 with collegiate basilica, museum, and Wiltener Sängerknaben.

1660.name: Streif & Hahnenkamm-Stadion
1660.kurzbeschreibung: The legendary Streif in Kitzbühel is the world's most spectacular downhill ski course, accessible in summer via an interactive themed hiking trail.

1661.name: Grawa-Wasserfall
1661.kurzbeschreibung: The Grawa Waterfall in the Stubai Valley is the Eastern Alps' widest cascade at 85 m, dropping 180 m with an alpine health lounger observatory.

1662.name: Stubai Glacier
