1662.kurzbeschreibung: The Stubai Glacier at up to 3,210 m in the Stubai Valley: Austria's largest glacier ski resort featuring the Top of Tyrol viewing platform and a walk-in ice cave.

1663.name: stubaier-gletscher-top-of-tyrol-plattform
1663.kurzbeschreibung: The Top of Tyrol viewing platform extends cantilevered at 3,210 metres over the Stubaier Gletscher, offering views of over 100 three-thousand-metre peaks.

1664.name: Stubnerkogel Suspension Bridge & Viewing Platform
1664.kurzbeschreibung: The 140 m long suspension bridge on the Stubnerkogel at 2,200 m above sea level: airy panoramic views, the Glocknerblick viewing platform, and the Felsenweg in the high mountains.

1665.name: Stuibenfälle im Außerfern
1665.kurzbeschreibung: The Stuibenfälle Waterfalls near Reutte and Breitenwang are dramatic tiered cascades of the Archbach river featuring suspension bridges, belvederes, and trails linking to Lake Plansee.

1666.name: Stuibenfall Umhausen
1666.kurzbeschreibung: Dropping 159 m near Umhausen in the Ötztal, Stuibenfall is Tyrol's highest waterfall, accessed via suspension bridges, 700 steps, and a via ferrata.

1667.name: stuibenfall-klettersteig-umhausen
1667.kurzbeschreibung: The Stuibenfall-Klettersteig in Umhausen ascends spectacularly alongside Tirol's highest waterfall, featuring a suspension bridge over the spray.

1668.name: stuibenfall-umhausen-oetztal-kaskaden
1668.kurzbeschreibung: Plunging 159 metres, the Stuibenfall in Umhausen is Tyrol's highest waterfall, accessible via 700 steps and a suspension bridge.

1669.name: Swarovski Kristallwelten
1669.kurzbeschreibung: Swarovski Crystal Worlds in Wattens dazzles visitors with 18 subterranean chambers of wonder and expansive landscaped gardens featuring a sparkling crystal cloud.

1670.name: swarovski-kristallwelten-wattens-erlebnis
1670.kurzbeschreibung: The Swarovski Kristallwelten in Wattens enchant visitors with 18 subterranean Chambers of Wonder, the water-spouting Giant, and the Crystal Cloud.

1671.name: Tannheimer Tal
1671.kurzbeschreibung: The Tannheimer Tal at 1,100 m in the Allgäu Alps is hailed as Europe's most enchanting high valley, featuring Lake Vilsalpsee, Haldensee, cable cars, and limestone peaks.

1672.name: Ruine Thierberg & Aussichtswarte
1672.kurzbeschreibung: The ruins of Thierberg Castle north of Kufstein entice visitors with an observation tower, pilgrimage chapel, historic nativity scene, and forest trail.

1673.name: Tiefenbachklamm
1673.kurzbeschreibung: Tiefenbachklamm between Brandenberg and Kramsach: spectacular 4 km gorge trail along the Brandenberger Ache with viewing platform and timber floating history.

1674.name: tiefenbachklamm-kramsach
1674.kurzbeschreibung: The Tiefenbachklamm between Kramsach and Brandenberg fascinates with bizarre rock formations and a spectacular suspension bridge.

1675.name: tiefenbachklamm-kramsach-brandenberg
1675.kurzbeschreibung: The Tiefenbachklamm near Kramsach impresses with the roaring whirlpools of the Brandenberger Ache, rocky footbridges, and a spectacular viewing platform.

1676.name: Timmelsjoch Experience & Pass Museum
1676.kurzbeschreibung: The Passmuseum Timmelsjoch at 2,509 m: bold architecture jutting over the abyss, architectural discovery trail, and border crossing into South Tyrol.

1677.name: timmelsjoch-hochalpenstrasse-passmuseum
1677.kurzbeschreibung: The Timmelsjoch Hochalpenstrasse links Tyrol with South Tyrol, impressing travellers with spectacular architecture and the Passmuseum.

1678.name: Timoks Wilde Welt Fieberbrunn
1678.kurzbeschreibung: Timoks Wilde Welt at Streuböden in Fieberbrunn at 1,210 m: Alpine Coaster, forest rope course, climbing park, and water games in Pillerseetal.

1679.name: Tiroler Bienenwelt Schönwies
1679.kurzbeschreibung: Tiroler Bienenwelt in Schönwies: an interactive 1,000 m² beekeeping museum with observation beehives, honey tastings, and a show distillery.

1680.name: 1. Tiroler Holzmuseum Auffach
1680.kurzbeschreibung: The 1st Tyrolean Wood Museum in Auffach in the Wildschönau showcases over 3,000 fascinating wood carvings, antique tools, and curiosities by artist Hubert Salcher.

1681.name: tiroler-holzmuseum-auffach-wildschoenau-kunst
1681.kurzbeschreibung: The Tiroler Holzmuseum in Auffach showcases more than 3,000 exhibits dedicated to wood as a material and the historic craft of woodcarving.

1682.name: 1st Tyrolean Wood Museum Wildschönau
1682.kurzbeschreibung: The 1st Tyrolean Wood Museum in Auffach in the Wildschönau: over 3,000 fascinating wooden exhibits in the rustic birthplace of woodcarver Hubert Salcher.

1683.name: Tiroler Landesmuseum Ferdinandeum
1683.kurzbeschreibung: The Tyrolean State Museum Ferdinandeum in Innsbruck showcases celebrated collections spanning from the Stone Age to contemporary art.

1684.name: tiroler-landesmuseum-ferdinandeum-innsbruck
1684.kurzbeschreibung: As a universal museum, the Ferdinandeum in Innsbruck spans a fascinating arc from the Stone Age to contemporary art.

1685.name: Tiroler Schnapsmuseum Pill
1685.kurzbeschreibung: The Tiroler Schnapsmuseum in Pill near Schwaz: historic Plankenhof palace distillery with copper stills and tastings of fine fruit brandies.

1686.name: Tiroler Steinöl Vitalberg Pertisau
1686.kurzbeschreibung: The Tiroler Steinöl Vitalberg in Pertisau on Lake Achensee: glass museum celebrating the "black gold of the Alps", Bächelsberg tunnel, and panorama café.

1687.name: Tiroler Volkskunstmuseum
1687.kurzbeschreibung: The Tyrolean Folk Art Museum in Innsbruck exhibits historic wood-paneled parlors, traditional costumes, carnival masks, and nativity crèches.

1688.name: tiroler-volkskunstmuseum-innsbruck
1688.kurzbeschreibung: The Tiroler Volkskunstmuseum in Innsbruck showcases historic farmhouse parlours, traditional costumes, carnival customs, and masterly nativity scenes.

1689.name: top-mountain-motorcycle-museum-crosspoint
1689.kurzbeschreibung: The Top Mountain Motorcycle Museum on the Timmelsjoch showcases over 500 historic motorcycles and rare technological milestones at 2,175 metres.

1690.name: Trattenbachtal & Trattenbachalm
1690.kurzbeschreibung: The Trattenbachtal in the Kitzbühel Alps is a tranquil alpine valley in the Hohe Salve region featuring traditional dairy pastures, clear mountain streams, and Kröndlhorn views.

1691.name: triassic-center-waidring-steinplatte
1691.kurzbeschreibung: The Triassic Center on the Steinplatte Waidring invites visitors on an interactive journey of discovery into alpine prehistoric times 200 million years ago.

1692.name: Triassic Park Steinplatte
1692.kurzbeschreibung: Triassic Park on the 1,700 m high Steinplatte in Waidring: prehistoric petrified coral sea, dinosaur models, Triassic Beach, and stalactite cave.

1693.name: triassic-park-steinplatte-waidring-dino
1693.kurzbeschreibung: Triassic Park on the Steinplatte Waidring whisks families away to prehistoric times with life-sized dinosaurs, a coral platform, and a water beach.

1694.name: triassic-park-waidring-steinplatte
1694.kurzbeschreibung: The Triassic Park on the Steinplatte Waidring invites families on an exciting journey back in time to 200 million years ago.

1695.name: Trisannabrücke
1695.kurzbeschreibung: Spectacular 87-metre-high railway arch bridge of the Arlbergbahn spanning the Trisanna gorge near Pians, crowned by medieval Schloss Wiesberg.

1696.name: Tristacher See
1696.kurzbeschreibung: Lake Tristacher See near Lienz is East Tyrol's sole natural bathing lake at 821 m beneath the Lienz Dolomites, featuring a public lido, woodland loop, and dining.

1697.name: tristacher-see-lienz-osttirol
1697.kurzbeschreibung: Tristacher See near Lienz is the only bathing lake in Osttirol and captivates with its setting beneath the Lienzer Dolomiten.

1698.name: Triumphpforte Innsbruck
1698.kurzbeschreibung: The Baroque Triumphpforte in Innsbruck: erected in 1765 by Empress Maria Theresia, it celebrates the wedding of her son Leopold and mourns Emperor Franz I.

1699.name: Untere Isar & Karwendelschlucht
1699.kurzbeschreibung: The pristine Untere Isarklamm (Gleirschklamm) near Scharnitz enchants hikers with emerald pools and a dramatic, wild gorge in the Karwendel.

1700.name: urisee-reutte-natursee
1700.kurzbeschreibung: The Urisee near Reutte is a crystal-clear natural lake up to 38 metres deep, offering free swimming access and diving grounds.

1701.name: Venet & Venetbahn
1701.kurzbeschreibung: Mount Venet (2,208 m Krahberg) above Landeck/Zams offers 360-degree panoramas of over 80 alpine peaks, Tyrol’s highest observatory, and Tobi’s adventure trail.

1702.name: Vilsalpsee
1702.kurzbeschreibung: Lake Vilsalpsee at 1,165 m in the Tannheimer Tal is an emerald alpine jewel cradled in a pristine nature reserve beneath Gaishorn peak, with waterside trails and rustic pastures.

1703.name: vilsalpsee-tannheimer-tal
1703.kurzbeschreibung: Vilsalpsee lies idyllically nestled within the nature reserve of the Tannheimer Tal, framed by steep alpine peaks.

1704.name: Virgental & Umbalfälle
1704.kurzbeschreibung: The sun-kissed Virgental valley in East Tyrol is a pristine alpine valley in the Hohe Tauern National Park, home to the thunderous Umbal Waterfalls.

1705.name: Tiroler Steinöl Vitalberg Pertisau
1705.kurzbeschreibung: The Vitalberg Tyrolean Shale Oil Museum in Pertisau on Lake Achensee: futuristic glass mountain showcasing the history of Alpine 'Black Gold' since 1902.

1706.name: vitalberg-tiroler-steinol-pertisau
1706.kurzbeschreibung: The Vitalberg experience center in Pertisau presents the history, extraction, and benefits of healing Tiroler Steinöl.

1707.name: Vitalpinum Thal-Assling
1707.kurzbeschreibung: The Vitalpinum in Thal-Assling (Osttirol): 7,000 m² Alpine wellness park with a historic mountain pine oil distillery, barefoot path, and herb garden.

1708.name: vitalpinum-thal-assling-erlebnisgarten
1708.kurzbeschreibung: Vitalpinum in Thal-Assling is an alpine sensory garden focusing on medicinal herbs, mountain pine oil distillation, Kneipp wellness, and relaxation.

1709.name: walchsee-kaiserwinkl-badesee
1709.kurzbeschreibung: Walchsee in the Kaiserwinkl is a warm, spacious swimming lake featuring water skiing, an aqua park, and panoramic Kaiser views.

1710.name: waldbad-kirchbichl-moorstrandbad
1710.kurzbeschreibung: Moorstrandbad Kirchbichl is one of Tirol's oldest outdoor pools, offering healing moor water amidst lush greenery.
